contracts.semantic_contract: Treat each parsed item as an indivisible item with one nonnegative scalar weight and each selected non-item capacity line as the common per-bin capacity. Assign every item to exactly one of a minimum number of identical bins, with each bin's total weight no greater than capacity. The examples use different units across instances; values are interpreted within each instance.

invariants: Each item record has an identifier and one numeric weight slot after its colon.
Exactly one non-item line selects the capacity scalar in each supplied example.
Every item is assigned to exactly one used bin.
The sum of item weights in each used bin does not exceed capacity.
The objective minimizes the number of used bins.
Used bins obey the fixed used-bins-prefix symmetry convention.

metamorphic_tests.expectation: Feasibility and the minimum number of used bins remain unchanged; assignments may be relabeled to match item identifiers.
metamorphic_tests.transform: Permute the item records while preserving each identifier and weight and leaving the capacity line unchanged.

metamorphic_tests.expectation: Feasibility and the minimum number of used bins remain unchanged.
metamorphic_tests.transform: Multiply every item weight and the capacity by the same positive factor.
